init.label: Road miles to base
init.expr: ROUND(1.25 * 3958.8 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(SIN(RADIANS(@[Base Lat] - @Latitude) / 2) ^ 2 + COS(RADIANS(@Latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(@[Base Lat])) * SIN(RADIANS(@[Base Lon] - @Longitude) / 2) ^ 2)), 1)

stringLiterals.values: Sites, Class I Sites, Incidents per Yr, Drive Hours per Yr

init.label: Average response
init.expr: IF(@[Sum of Incidents per Yr] > 0, ROUND(@[Sum of Drive Hours per Yr] * 30 / @[Sum of Incidents per Yr], 1), 0)
